raw.comments: Added a paper-faithful Rado support package: IncreasingPair, the exact two-clause RadoOrder, SetDomination, RelationEmbedding, BadPairSequence, the powerset bad-witness equivalence, CardinalityFront, and the triple and quadruple homogeneous consequences of NashWilliams. Every new proof-bearing TeX file has a complete cited proof. The full tablet shape check and Lean build pass. The exact lines 985--987 embedding theorem was not introduced because its detailed preservation/reflection proof is the downstream Rado-target task.
raw.summary: Built the Rado pair-order, powerset domination and bad-witness support, relation embeddings, and Nash-Williams thinning lemmas for triples and quadruples.
